I've updated the TestimonyCard component to display the source (witness) name and their profile picture underneath the testimony text. Now when a testimony is displayed in the mindmap, it will:

1. Show the testimony text
2. Display the witness's photo in a small circular avatar (if available)
3. If no photo is available, show a circular avatar with the first initial of the witness's name
4. Show the witness's name beside their avatar

The styling is consistent with the application's existing UI - using neutral colors, appropriate sizing, and maintaining the clean aesthetic of the application.
